name: ceol-universe
description: A public inventory of candidate English strings, each with its provenance. Every row is a candidate, never a verdict. The card (README.md) states its limitations first.
citeAs: Ryan Kamp, The CEOL Universe, version v2.1, Hugging Face dataset ryanjosephkamp/ceol-universe.

recordSet.name: universe
recordSet.description: the pin's unrestricted rows, less the rows held back (card §6), in the public columns; 10264249 rows

field.name: id
field.description: the first 16 hexadecimal digits of the sha256 of the word's UTF-8 bytes; a function of the string alone, so the same string carries the same id in every version (null: never null)

field.name: word
field.description: the candidate string, the output of the grammar: lower case, the 50-character charset, spaces single and interior; the join key of every layer (null: never null)

field.name: eol
field.description: in the EOL's valid list at the pinned revision 08ae92b8: a historical fact at a pin, carried as a covariate, never a CEOL verdict (null: never null)

field.name: eol_universe
field.description: in the EOL's pinned candidate universe (its valid or its invalid list); false for the CEOL's own 3 layers (null: never null)

field.name: classes
field.description: the grammar's non-exclusive class flags joined by ';' (hyphenated, accented, diaeresis, ligature, apostrophe-form, contraction, s-final, spaced); the empty string on a plain-letter string (null: never null)

field.name: sources
field.description: provenance at intake: for the CEOL's own layers the published sources whose derived sets contain the string, joined by ';', a withheld list's label removed (the empty string where each such source is withheld); for the strings inherited from the EOL the dataset-level tag eol_universe@08ae92b8 (their per-source listedness is the evidence columns') (null: never null)

field.name: intake_date
field.description: the date the row entered a CEOL artifact (an ISO date): August 17, 2026 the strings inherited from the EOL universe, August 20, 2026 the census's exception candidates and the audit's additions, August 26, 2026 the spaced admission's multiword candidates (null: never null)

field.name: c4_addition
field.description: a row of the audit's additions to the single-token pin (null: never null)

field.name: is_restricted
field.description: attested only by NWL2023 or CSW21; false on every row of this dataset, because those rows never ship (null: never null)

field.name: token_count
field.description: the number of space-separated tokens (null: never null)

field.name: c015_addition
field.description: a row of the multiword candidates of the spaced admission (null: never null)

field.name: wn_instance
field.description: WordNet instance-synset membership, a properness signal recorded and never filtered on (null: null unless WordNet attests the row; measured on the spaced layer only; null means not measured, never false)

field.name: wn_capitalized
field.description: WordNet data-file capitalization, a properness signal (null: null unless WordNet attests the row; measured on the spaced layer only)

field.name: wk_proper_noun
field.description: a Wiktionary Proper-noun heading, a properness signal (null: null unless Wiktionary attests the row; measured on the spaced layer only)

field.name: wk_flags
field.description: Wiktionary's category flags joined by ';' (idiomatic, phrasal-verb, phrasebook, proverb); may be the empty string (null: null unless Wiktionary attests the row; measured on the spaced layer only)

field.name: class_explicit
field.description: the pin's classes with the value 'plain' in place of the empty string; otherwise the flags unchanged (null: never null)

field.name: panel_sets
field.description: the published panel sets that list the row, joined by ';' in the order wordnet, wiktionary_english, hunspell_en_US, hunspell_en_GB, hunspell_en_CA, hunspell_en_AU, enable1, scowl; on a single-token row a binary set lists the row where its evidence column is 1 and SCOWL where scowl_tier is above 0; on a spaced row the sets are the pin's published sources; the empty string where none lists the row. A withheld list is never named (null: never null)

field.name: variety_gb_not_us
field.description: true where hunspell_en_GB is 1 and hunspell_en_US is 0: a proxy for a variety difference between the 2 dictionaries, never a variety label (null: null where either hunspell column is -1 or null)

field.name: variety_us_not_gb
field.description: true where hunspell_en_US is 1 and hunspell_en_GB is 0: the reverse proxy (null: null where either hunspell column is -1 or null)

field.name: intake_layer
field.description: the layer the row entered by: eol_valid, eol_invalid, c1_exceptions, c4_additions, spaced_c015 (null: never null)

field.name: intake_kind
field.description: obtained (an inherited string taken in through a channel), derived (a row of a CEOL layer derived from pinned sources), or generated (made by the EOL's lost synthetic engine) (null: never null)

field.name: intake_channels
field.description: the first-seen channel labels joined by ';': the EOL's discovery log with its tiers removed, and the CEOL layers' own namespaces census:, audit:, spaced:, ledger:; a record of where a string was first seen, never an attestation. A label naming a withheld list is removed, and so is a channel withheld for license reasons; a row whose every label was withheld carries the single label eol:channel-withheld. On a row of the EOL's valid list, only the labels of the intakes the EOL's own records name stay (eol:authoritative-extracts, eol:dictionary-api:free-dictionary, eol:extended-domain-sources, eol:invalid-list-recovery, eol:synthetic-engine), and a row left with none carries eol:list: the row says nothing else about how the EOL took the word in (null: never null)

field.name: eol_phase1_tier
field.description: the tier suffix the EOL's labels on the row share: valid, unlikely, or none (mixed where the labels disagree); none on every row of the EOL's valid list, whose rows say nothing about how the EOL took the word in (null: never null)

field.name: eol_record
field.description: which EOL dictionary holds the row's entry: valid-dict, invalid-dict, none (null: never null)

field.name: eol_synthetic_category
field.description: the category recorded on a generated string (a domain label, or the EOL validation step's judgment) (null: null on every row that is not generated)

field.name: eol_synthetic_engine_inferred
field.description: the engine and rule inferred from a generated string's form (affixation, chemical-variation, greek-plural, medical-scientific-prefixing, unresolved); an inference, so named (null: null on every row that is not generated)

field.name: panel_count
field.description: the number of the 8 published panel sets that list the row (the number of names in panel_sets, asserted equal on every row); a withheld list's listing is not counted (null: never null)

field.name: gb_type
field.description: the string is a Google Books English 1-gram type in the CEOL re-stream (null: null on spaced rows, which the corpora do not measure)

field.name: wordfreq_scored
field.description: wordfreq 3.1.1 scores the string (null: null on spaced rows, which the corpora do not measure)

field.name: wikt_title_any
field.description: some language's Wiktionary has a page titled with the string: a screen, not containment (null: null on spaced rows)

field.name: provenance_class
field.description: exactly 1 of channel_and_containment, channel_only, containment_only, neither, over the published fields: whether the row has a published intake channel (a label other than eol:phase1-unrecorded and eol:channel-withheld; eol:list counts) and whether a published panel set or a corpus contains it (null: never null)

field.name: wordnet
field.description: listed by WordNet 3.0's lemmas, re-derived under the CEOL grammar: 1 listed, 0 not listed, -1 structurally blind to the row's class (null: null on spaced rows, which the single-token sets were not measured over)

field.name: wiktionary_english
field.description: listed by Wiktionary pages with an English section (the August 4, 2026 dump): 1 listed, 0 not listed, -1 structurally blind to the row's class (null: null on spaced rows, which the single-token sets were not measured over)

field.name: hunspell_en_US
field.description: listed by the LibreOffice hunspell en_US dictionary, expanded: 1 listed, 0 not listed, -1 structurally blind to the row's class (null: null on spaced rows, which the single-token sets were not measured over)

field.name: hunspell_en_GB
field.description: listed by the LibreOffice hunspell en_GB dictionary, expanded: 1 listed, 0 not listed, -1 structurally blind to the row's class (null: null on spaced rows, which the single-token sets were not measured over)

field.name: hunspell_en_CA
field.description: listed by the LibreOffice hunspell en_CA dictionary, expanded: 1 listed, 0 not listed, -1 structurally blind to the row's class (null: null on spaced rows, which the single-token sets were not measured over)

field.name: hunspell_en_AU
field.description: listed by the LibreOffice hunspell en_AU dictionary, expanded: 1 listed, 0 not listed, -1 structurally blind to the row's class (null: null on spaced rows, which the single-token sets were not measured over)

field.name: enable1
field.description: listed by the ENABLE word list: 1 listed, 0 not listed, -1 structurally blind to the row's class (null: null on spaced rows, which the single-token sets were not measured over)

field.name: scowl_tier
field.description: the SCOWL size tier (10 to 95) of the smallest SCOWL list holding the string; 0 not listed; -1 not applicable to the row's class (null: null on spaced rows)

field.name: wikt_title_screen
field.description: 1 where some language's Wiktionary has a page titled with the string, else 0: a screen, never a detector (null: null on spaced rows)

field.name: model_or_engine
field.description: engine_generated on a row the EOL's synthetic engine made (intake_kind generated); none on every other row. Whether a language model took part in the EOL's decision on a word is a fact of how the EOL took it in, and no row carries it (null: never null)

recordSet.name: features
recordSet.description: token_count == 1 over universe; id, word, and the feature layer's columns; 9969384 rows

field.name: id
field.description: the first 16 hexadecimal digits of the sha256 of the word's UTF-8 bytes; a function of the string alone, so the same string carries the same id in every version (null: never null)

field.name: word
field.description: the candidate string, the output of the grammar: lower case, the 50-character charset, spaces single and interior; the join key of every layer (null: never null)

field.name: gb_year_span
field.description: the years from the first to the last in which the string occurs in the Google Books English 1-grams (the 2020 release), inclusive (null: 0 where the string is not a 1-gram type)

field.name: gb_span_fill
field.description: the share of the span's years in which the string occurs (null: NaN where the string is not a 1-gram type)

field.name: gb_tokens_per_volume
field.description: the total match count over the total volume count (null: NaN where no volume carries the string)

field.name: gb_volumes_per_year
field.description: the total volume count over the years in which the string occurs (null: NaN where the string is not a 1-gram type)

field.name: gb_log10_match
field.description: log10 of the total match count (null: NaN where the string is not a 1-gram type)

field.name: gb_log10_volume
field.description: log10 of the total volume count (null: NaN where no volume carries the string)

field.name: zipf_log10_rank
field.description: log10 of the string's frequency rank among the aggregate's types (null: NaN where the string is not a 1-gram type)

field.name: zipf_resid
field.description: log10 of the match count minus the Zipf-Mandelbrot fit's prediction at that rank (null: NaN where the string is not a 1-gram type)

field.name: wordfreq_zipf
field.description: the wordfreq 3.1.1 Zipf frequency (English) where wordfreq's list holds the string (null: NaN elsewhere, and on every hyphenated string (wordfreq is hyphen-blind))
